import MilneLib.SymmetricPower.SymmetricPower

/-!
# Open immersions of relative powers

Finite relative powers preserve open immersions. This supplies the open
subscheme of the relative power used in Milne III.3, Proposition 3.1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib

variable {S : Scheme.{u}}

private theorem over_prodMap_isOpenImmersion {V W V' W' : Over S}
    (f : V ⟶ W) (g : V' ⟶ W') [IsOpenImmersion f.left] [IsOpenImmersion g.left] :
    IsOpenImmersion (prod.map f g).left := by
  let m := pullback.map V.hom V'.hom W.hom W'.hom f.left g.left (𝟙 S)
    (by simp) (by simp)
  have hm : IsOpenImmersion m :=
    MorphismProperty.pullbackMap (P := @IsOpenImmersion) inferInstance inferInstance
      f.w.symm g.w.symm
  have he : (prod.map f g).left =
      (Over.prodLeftIsoPullback V V').hom ≫ m ≫
        (Over.prodLeftIsoPullback W W').inv := by
    apply (cancel_mono (Over.prodLeftIsoPullback W W').hom).mp
    apply pullback.hom_ext <;>
      simp [m, pullback.map, pullback.lift_fst, pullback.lift_snd,
        ← Over.comp_left]
  rw [he]
  letI := hm
  infer_instance

private noncomputable def relativePowerSuccIso (V : Over S) (n : ℕ) :
    V ⨯ relativePower V n ≅ relativePower V (n + 1) :=
  (extendFanIsLimit (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => V)
    (limit.isLimit (Discrete.functor (fun _ : Fin n => V)))
    (prodIsProd V (relativePower V n))).conePointUniqueUpToIso (limit.isLimit _)

private theorem relativePowerSuccIso_hom_projection (V : Over S) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (relativePowerSuccIso V n).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => V) i =
      Fin.cases prod.fst (fun j => prod.snd ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : Fin n => V) j) i := by
  exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_hom_comp
    (extendFanIsLimit (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => V)
      (limit.isLimit (Discrete.functor (fun _ : Fin n => V)))
      (prodIsProd V (relativePower V n))) (limit.isLimit _) (Discrete.mk i)

private theorem relativePowerSuccIso_naturality {V W : Over S} (f : V ⟶ W) (n : ℕ) :
    (relativePowerSuccIso V n).hom ≫ relativePowerMap f (n + 1) =
      prod.map f (relativePowerMap f n) ≫ (relativePowerSuccIso W n).hom := by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro i
  rw [Category.assoc, relativePowerMap_comp_projection, ← Category.assoc,
    relativePowerSuccIso_hom_projection, Category.assoc,
    relativePowerSuccIso_hom_projection]
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · simp
  · simp [Category.assoc]

/-- The map of finite relative powers induced by an open immersion is an open
immersion, including the zeroth power over any base scheme. -/
theorem relativePowerMap_isOpenImmersion {V W : Over S} (f : V ⟶ W) (n : ℕ)
    [IsOpenImmersion f.left] : IsOpenImmersion (relativePowerMap f n).left := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have hV : IsTerminal (relativePower V 0) :=
      isLimitEquivIsTerminalOfIsEmpty (Over S) _
        (limit.isLimit (Discrete.functor (fun _ : Fin 0 => V)))
    have hW : IsTerminal (relativePower W 0) :=
      isLimitEquivIsTerminalOfIsEmpty (Over S) _
        (limit.isLimit (Discrete.functor (fun _ : Fin 0 => W)))
    have he : relativePowerMap f 0 = (hV.uniqueUpToIso hW).hom := hW.hom_ext _ _
    rw [he]
    infer_instance
  | succ n ih =>
    letI := ih
    have he : relativePowerMap f (n + 1) =
        (relativePowerSuccIso V n).inv ≫ prod.map f (relativePowerMap f n) ≫
          (relativePowerSuccIso W n).hom := by
      rw [← relativePowerSuccIso_naturality, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [he, Over.comp_left, Over.comp_left]
    letI := over_prodMap_isOpenImmersion f (relativePowerMap f n)
    infer_instance

end MilneLib
